fit_reason: Private seller listing a whole 2012 Ford F-150 crew cab truck.
findings: Hazy, yellowed headlight lenses on both front headlights
Red paint looks somewhat flat and dull along the bed side and rear door in the third photo
Dirt and grime on the lower body and chrome rocker trim near the rear wheel
Dusty, dull wheel with grime on the spokes and dry-looking tire sidewall in the close-up
Light dirt film on the hood and front bumper area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-150. The headlights look a bit hazy and the red paint on the bed side has gone a little flat in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details that include a wash, buff and headlight restoration, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
